observations: Photo 0: one aluminium worm gear speed reducer (the square finned NMRV style gearbox) sitting on a cardboard sheet.
Photo 0: a round motor input flange with a hollow input bore and keyway faces the camera; a hollow output bore with mounting bosses is on the left side.
Photo 0: an oil plug or breather hole is on the top of the finned housing.
Photo 0: the casting is bright and clean with no visible scratches, rust, oil leaks or broken lugs.
Photo 0: no nameplate is visible, so the maker, frame size and gear ratio cannot be read; no motor is attached.
Photo 0: only one angle, the item is not shown turning or mounted, and no box or receipt is shown.
Photo 0 carries a 'Posted on Jiji' watermark and a shop name.

identity.kind: worm gear speed reducer (aluminium gearbox, no motor)
read_from: photo 0 finned worm gearbox housing, input flange and hollow output bore

claims.claim: This is a motor speed reducer
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a worm gear reducer housing with a motor input flange and hollow output.
Photo 0 shows a clean bright casting with no wear from one angle; the other sides and the nameplate are not shown.
No close photo of the cover bolts or seals.
No clip of the shafts turning smoothly or of it running on a motor.
No receipt or warranty card shown.

risks.risk: Frame size and gear ratio unknown; a small frame or an unwanted ratio is worth less.
risks.proof: A close photo of the nameplate showing maker, frame size and ratio, with a tape measure across the flange.
risks.if_unproven: as the smallest common frame size

risks.risk: Worm or wheel may be worn, bearings rough, or seals leaking; it may have no oil.
risks.proof: A clip of the input turned by hand or on a motor showing the output turning smoothly with no play or noise, and the oil plug opened.

risks.risk: Housing may be cracked or a mounting lug broken on the sides not shown.
risks.proof: Photos of all sides and the underside of the gearbox.

risks.risk: Photo may be a shop stock image and not the unit being sold.
risks.proof: A photo of the gearbox with a handwritten note carrying today's date and a code we give.
risks.if_unproven: identity confirmed at collection before money moves

proof_requests: Close photo of the nameplate with maker, frame size and ratio, and a tape measure across the flange.
Clip of the input shaft turned and the output turning smoothly with no play or noise.
Photos of all sides and the underside of the gearbox.
Photo of the gearbox with a handwritten code and today's date.
response.reason: Photo 0 clearly shows an aluminium worm gear speed reducer, so it is priced by type at its worst case: smallest common frame size and not working. The nameplate and a turning clip would raise it.
